text:
maria: FYI rolling kernel 6.4.3 -> eu-west2 completed ~05:12 UTC, but seeing a subset of P4 hosts fail to probe the nvidia driver, nodes marking NotReady.
aj: logs?
kai: example dmesg from one host: `modprobe: FATAL: Module nvidia not found in directory /lib/modules/6.4.3-5-generic` then repeated `kernel: nvidia: module verification failed: signature and/or required key missing`
olivia: also seeing device disappear events in kubelet: `error: failed to start metrics server: no devices found`
maria: NCCL jobs started hitting handshake timeouts and CUDA init errors, roughly 7-9% of P4s in the region.
aj: deploy-bot rolled the kernel batch, any DKMS steps ran?
deploy-bot: Rolling kernel update to 6.4.3 completed in eu-west2 for batch 42. (CI/CD)
infra-bot: Auto-remediation tried `dkms install -m nvidia -v 535.86` on some hosts; 60% succeeded, remaining show /usr/src/nvidia-535 missing.
kai: suspect the package cache eviction during image build removed /usr/src. Also seeing `taint: loading out-of-tree module` on some kernels then OOMs later.
olivia: can we cordon affected nodes and shift queued jobs to us-west1 temporarily? that region has spare capacity but higher egress to EU clients.
maria: yes cordoning now. moving training/rl jobs to us-west1. will keep inference in eu since we need low latency.
aj: action items: 1) collect /lib/modules list and `dkms status` from failing hosts, 2) try manual `dkms add` then `dkms build && dkms install`, 3) hold kernel package if it's the culprit.
kai: quick debug snippet I ran: ```ssh host-123 \"ls -la /lib/modules/6.4.3* && dkms status || true\"``` shows missing nvidia-535 source on bad hosts.
oncall: we should open a support case with vendor if DKMS sources vanished at scale. this smells like image bake step race.
maria: re-baking image with explicit /usr/src/nvidia-535 copy and a post-install dkms rebuild. starting a bake now for a small canary pool.
aj: what's the rollback plan if canary fails?
maria: plan A: rollback kernel to 6.3.x via package hold and reboot affected nodes sequentially. Plan B: if rollback blocked, move non-latency-critical workloads to Dedicated capacity in eu-west2 (we have reserved P4s) — cost up but keeps SLAs.
kai: note: if we start reverting kernels we might need to recompile modules for 6.3. Ensure we keep matching gcc/cross-toolchain.
olivia: I've notified infra-ops and cost control: moving jobs to Dedicated will burn extra reserved capacity but prevents customer impact.
aj: timeline?
maria: canary bake expected ready in ~20m, then promote to 50 hosts if green. If not green we start rollback and will update in #incidents.
oncall: tagging on-call SRE for morning shift overlap. @oncall please monitor NCCL failure alerts and scale jobs out of region as needed.
infra-bot: Created incident INC-20260318-01 for kernel/nvidia probe failures in eu-west2.
maria: adding a short runbook note: - cordon affected nodes - capture `dmesg` + `/var/log/dkms` - try `sudo dkms install -m nvidia -v 535.86` - if module missing, restore /usr/src from artifact repo and rerun dkms - if >5% hosts affected, trigger rollback.
aj: thanks. i'll start collecting dkms outputs and attach to the incident.
kai: quick grep shows the bake pipeline skipped copying /usr/src on image cache miss between 05:05-05:10 — opening a PR to add explicit sync.
maria: good catch. once canary passes we'll deploy fix and then start rolling uncordon.
olivia: leaving a note for finance: short-term Dedicated usage will cost ~€3k/day extra for this region; will approve for customer SLA preservation.
oncall: monitoring dashboards: tokenized latency ok, throughput impacted for batch jobs. will post updates to INC-20260318-01. :alarm_clock:
